content: pykrx (sharebook-kr) scrapes KRX. get_market_ohlcv(start,end,ticker) returns daily OHLCV DataFrame; get_market_cap returns per-ticker market cap/volume/value/shares for a date; get_market_fundamental(_by_date) returns PER/PBR/EPS/DIV/BPS/DPS. Supports KOSPI/KOSDAQ/KONEX and get_market_ticker_list. Compose these for daily screening by volume/momentum/fundamentals.
